{{Quote|I'll be taking a diving trip to the resort world of Kaal soon, and a friend offered to loan me an organic gill. Catch is, I gotta pick it up. If you help me out, I'll pay you.|An unidentified citizen, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GGaG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal|Explorer|Go Get a Gill}}</ref>}}
The '''organic gill''', sometimes known as an '''oxygen symbiote''' was a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] that allowed most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to breathe [[Water/Legends|underwater]] for an indefinite period of time.

==Characteristics==
The gill was manufactured by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] using an engineered biotechnological symbiont that extracted breathable gaseous [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] by filtering it from [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Water/Legends|water]]. Taking the form of a small, transparent, gelatinous blob, the organic gill fit over a wearer's [[Nose/Legends|nose]] and [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. Using the gills meant that there was no need for conventional [[air tank]]s or cumbersome breathing apparatus.<ref name="EGWT" />

The gill was capable of having several physical implants placed into it to increase its utility, such as chin protectors, [[Goggles/Legends|goggle]] clamps, [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] transceivers, [[Microphone/Legends|microphones]] and [[earphones]]. These components were slid into the gill, which conformed around them and held them in place. Each organic gill cost two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]],<ref name="EGWT" /> and weighed one-tenth of a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]].<ref name="AE" />

Organic gill wearers could travel underwater for an indefinite period of time, and did not have to worry about drowning. Putting on the gill was uncomfortable for most beings at first, although they were quick to adapt to it without much difficulty. This made the gill popular with tourists and explorers alike. Designed for the Mon Calamari and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], most other [[Species/Legends|species]] were capable of using them; [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] however could not use organic gills because they were allergic to them.<ref name="EGWT" />

The symbiont lived for several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]].<ref name="EGWT" /> It could be used for about one [[Standard month/Legends|month]], then the gill died and became useless.<ref name="AE" />

==History==
[[File:Organic_Gill.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Mon Calamari Organic gill]]
Though they were amphibious and could stay underwater indefinitely, the Mon Calamari generally found breathing water somewhat uncomfortable and preferred to make use of organic gills whenever possible.<ref name="DB">{{DB|species|moncalamari|Mon Calamari}}</ref> 

[[Minister of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] utilized an organic gill when she visited [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to find [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] after the disaster on [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]]. She and her guide, [[Cilghal]] used the gills to travel for hours under the water to the [[Knowledge Bank]], which gave the location of the Admiral's whereabouts.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' 32]] stated that Mon Calamari can breathe underwater, however other sources indicated that they have to use an organic gill to stay underwater for an extended period of time. The official StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]] made the compromise that they find it uncomfortable and prefer to use an organic gill.
